subject: Re: AtlasAI RFP — neutral bakeoff credits and proposal
messages:
From: Donna Su <donna.su@atlasai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Troy Miller <troy.miller@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasAI RFP — request for neutral evaluation credits

Hi Markus,

We're running an RFP this quarter and AtlasAI will be doing blind bake-offs across three vendors. One of the mandatory asks from our evaluation committee is equal and neutral resource allocation for each vendor so we can measure throughput and latency head-to-head.

High-level ask: 50k tokens of generation credit (spread across both chat and instruction models), an isolated sandbox that can run up to 4 concurrent worker instances, and access to the same model revisions for 2 weeks. We also need a short statement confirming that we won't be throttled/biased compared to paid customers during the window.

Attached is the RFP excerpt with evaluation criteria and our expected workload (atlas-usage-estimate.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate this and what, if any, approvals are required?

Thanks — Donna
Donna Su
Head of Platform Engineering, AtlasAI

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Donna Su <donna.su@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI RFP — request for neutral evaluation credits

Donna — thanks for the detail and the RFP excerpt. We definitely want Redwood to be a fair contender here. A few quick clarifying questions so I can route this properly to Sales Ops and Legal:

- The 50k tokens: is that total across models or per vendor? (Your note implies total per vendor.)
- You mention "isolated sandbox" — do you need a VPC-private evaluation or is a tenant-isolated hosted sandbox sufficient?
- Any SSO/KMS requirements for the short window?

Tentative offer: we can provision a dedicated sandbox with model pinning and commit the 50k-token credit if we get an approval exception to our standard RFP cap (our default eval stipend is lower for blind bake-offs). I9ll loop in Ben (Sales Ops) and Marissa (AE) to confirm the operational steps and to get an approval pathway. Expect a follow-up by EOD.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: AtlasAI RFP — request for neutral evaluation credits (ops need approval)

Folks — forwarding AtlasAI request. Summary:
- External asks: 50k tokens per vendor, 2-week isolated sandbox, 4 concurrent worker capacity.
- Atlas explicitly wants parity across vendors for the RFP window.
- Attached: Atlas_RFP.pdf and atlas-usage-estimate.xlsx (see attachments).

Our standard bakeoff stipend is 15k tokens for hosted sandboxes. This is a material exception (50k). Also they9re asking for isolation and pinned model revisions which carries ops cost.

Recommendation: approve a conditional 40k top-up (bringing to 55k total) on the following terms: 1) milestone-based usage — 50% released up front, 50% after validation of usage/attestation that the environment was used for the RFP window; 2) Atlas must sign a short Eval Terms doc that limits data retention and confirms no scraping of internal logs; 3) legal to sign off on the no-throttle statement.

I9m marking as urgent to Priyom for approval and Legal loop. Ben
(Attachment stubs: Atlas_RFP.pdf, atlas-usage-estimate.xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: AtlasAI RFP — request for neutral evaluation credits (ops need approval)

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the RFP excerpt. I9m okay approving the exception with these conditions:
1) Offer 55k tokens total (15k standard + 40k exception) scoped to a 2-week window.
2) Release schedule: 30k up front, remaining 25k after a brief post-run attestation and usage report.
3) Provide a hosted tenant-isolated sandbox (no VPC unless we sign an enterprise pilot). That will reduce lead time.
4) Legal to finalize a 2-page Eval Terms addendum (I9ll ask Legal for a rapid review) and Security to provide a short SOC2 statement that covers the sandbox SLA.
5) Attach our draft terms and ask Atlas to sign via DocuSign before we create the environment.

Ben/Markus: proceed to draft the Eval Terms and the DocuSign packet. Marissa: please propose dates next week for the kickoff and include the usage estimation worksheet in the package. I9ll escalate for a one-time credit exception in the FY approvals log.

Priyom
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
(Attachment stub: redwood-eval-terms-draft.pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Donna Su <donna.su@atlasai.com>, Troy Miller <troy.miller@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI RFP — request for neutral evaluation credits

Donna/Troy — appreciate the quick turnaround. We can support AtlasAI's bakeoff under the following final terms: 

- Credit allocation: 55,000 tokens total for Redwood (30k up front, 25k after post-run attestation).
- Environment: Hosted tenant-isolated sandbox with pinned model revisions. Up to 4 concurrent worker instances will be permitted.
- Timing: 2-week evaluation window (dates to be confirmed).
- Security & compliance: Redwood will provide a short SOC2 summary for the sandbox and will commit to not throttling evaluation traffic beyond standard platform protections; Legal will add explicit language in the Eval Terms addendum.
- Next steps: Please review and sign the attached Eval Terms (DocuSign link). Once signed, we'll provision the sandbox and share the onboarding runbook.

Attachments (stubs): redwood-eval-terms-draft.pdf, atlas-usage-estimate.xlsx, Atlas_RFP.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/prepare/XYZ-ATLAS-EVAL
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-ATLAS-2026-07

If this looks good, Marissa will schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week to confirm exact dates and the model revisions to pin.

—Markus
Senior Account Exec — Redwood Inference
